[RARC.5.6.11] **A read that reaches a binding before the
action establishing it has run is an unrecoverable fault**:
the engine must halt the tier ([LERR.1.4.7]).

The right-hand side runs in the order the artefact declares
(step 6, [RARC.5.6.7]). A read arriving ahead of its binding
means the declared order and the executed order disagree, so
the artefact is not describing the run the engine is
performing.

It is **not** an absent value, and the distinction is the
whole point: the binding is not missing, it is unreachable in
a rule set that was compiled correctly. Answering `null`
would turn a broken artefact into a rule that quietly does
not fire.
